# Synthetic packing component fixture

All prose, queries, references and observations are invented in English. The
neutral subject is felt sleeves and folded paper cradles for painted wooden
tiles. No experiment or gateway call was executed to produce this fixture.
DOIs use the 10.1000/synthetic.packing namespace. Any arxiv:9912.99xxx
identifier is an explicitly fictitious test identifier, never a citation.

JSON keys, array sizes, numeric simulation inputs and outputs, search call
kinds, error/empty distinctions, identifier equality relations and physical
journal line positions match the regression contracts. There are ten journal
files. Nineteen searches have unknown identifiers, eleven in the main run.
The other searches include repeated queries, empty results and successful hits.

This is a component fixture, not a complete check.py run. The card and report
are rendered snapshots; full lifecycle tests use the valid synthetic fixtures.
The separate legacy card snapshot tests every rendered byte with a pinned
fingerprint. Detector fixtures intentionally retain ellipses, omitted-list
pointers, unsupported recall claims and assumed outcomes.
